titulo: Helicopter Engineer - ACH135 | Yacht-Based | Med & Caribbean
descripcion_html:
A private Family Office is seeking a licensed Helicopter Engineer to join a yacht-based VIP helicopter operation (Airbus ACH135), combining maintenance responsibility with an onboard safety-crew role.

The Role

  • Full line and base maintenance responsibility for the aircraft, onboard the yacht's support vessel
  • Onboard safety-crew member, supporting the pilot during flight operations and in emergency scenarios
  • Coordination with the aircraft's CAMO/continuing-airworthiness provider and the yacht's technical team


Roster
3 weeks on / 3 weeks off, though in practice flexible around operational need — off time coordinated directly with the operating captain team rather than a rigid fixed pattern.

Requirements

  • EASA Part 66 (or UK CAA/GCAA equivalent) B1/B2 licence, valid type rating or ability to obtain one
  • Significant helicopter maintenance experience; VIP, yacht-based or offshore operational background strongly preferred
  • Additional safety-crew, hoist or rescue qualification an advantage
  • Fluent English
  • Based in Europe; flexible to reposition between the Mediterranean and Caribbean seasons
